class.name: LoadingScreen
class.brief_description: A [TransitionScreen] that shows the load progress in a progress bar and rotates tips.
class.description: A loading screen is a [TransitionScreen] with two optional helpers: it writes the load progress into the [Range] at [member progress_bar] (for example a [ProgressBar] or [TextureProgressBar]) and shows [member tips] one after another in the node at [member tip_label] (any node with a [code]text[/code] property: [Label], [RichTextLabel], [Button]). Design the loading screen as a scene with a [LoadingScreen] root, then start it with [method SceneTree.change_scene_with_transition]: [codeblocks] [gdscript] get_tree().change_scene_with_transition("res://levels/level_2.tscn", preload("res://ui/loading_screen.tscn")) [/gdscript] [csharp] GetTree().ChangeSceneWithTransition("res://levels/level_2.tscn", GD.Load<PackedScene>("res://ui/loading_screen.tscn")); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_current_tip
method.description: Returns the tip that is shown now, or an empty string if [member tips] is empty.

members.member: Format of the text written to [member count_label]: the number of loaded files and the total, for example [code]"%d / %d loaded"[/code]. An empty format clears the text.

Path to the node that shows how many files are loaded ("3 / 12"): any node with a [code]text[/code] property. The counts come from [method TransitionScreen.get_load_progress]: [member TransitionScreen.next_scene] counts as one file next to the files of [member TransitionScreen.preload_assets].
Path to a [Range] (for example a [ProgressBar]) that shows the load progress. It is set through [member Range.ratio], so any [member Range.min_value] and [member Range.max_value] work.
Seconds each tip is shown before the next one. [code]0.0[/code] keeps the first tip.
Path to the node that shows the tips: any node with a [code]text[/code] property, such as [Label], [RichTextLabel] or [Button].
Tips shown in order while the screen is visible, starting with the first one. Shuffle the array in a script for a random order. Translation keys are translated by the label as usual.
